note: Set A is preferred because it correctly attributes the cable specification without conflating it with the cable ties' UV rating (which Set B incorrectly assigns to the current carrying cable). Set B also misinterprets the legend symbol '3' as a quantity for SA2-26 and misplaces the bonding jumper '11' between SA2-19 and SA2-20. While Set A has a topological error connecting SA2-25 to the Weatherhead (it should be SA2-27) and contains some redundant claims, its semantic errors are fewer than Set B's misattributions of text notes and symbols.
